synth.notes:
Kick/slide token sokoban: arrows move player 3px; hitting a block kicks it instead (player stays).
Kicked chain slides 3px/step, absorbing blocks it hits, until a member leaves the hidden FLOOR, overlaps the player, or enters a socket interior of a different size.
Click on a block = player takes its rect, block consumed; blocks renamed token_i by (y,x). No global HUD/counter involved.
Step-78 fix: FLOOR gains an upper west corridor x18-29,y30-35 (stop at x=18); lone 6x6 stop at x=15 => rows 48-50 floor only x>=15, alcove x6-14,y42-47.
Open: floor rects inferred from stops (walls invisible, rows 36-41 west unobserved); fitting socket entry and actions 5/7 unobserved.
